blurb: What is worth reading today, checked against what the user actually cares about.
_whyRelayTimeout: 2026-10-04. The Daily Coordinator asks this assistant every morning. Its answers took 92-260 s (Oct 1-4, measured in the thread), and the default 120 s relay timeout dropped most of them: the answer arrived, was paid for, and was thrown away. 420 s covers that with room for the slot wait, which may take up to half the timeout (assistants/session-policy.json). Capped at 600 s by AssistantRelay.maxTurnTimeout.
_whyTheseWereAdded2026_09_29: Enforcement began 2026-09-29; assistant.getLatestBrief was in real use.
